Thanks again for moving quickly on the PO setup. We have a pending purchase order (PO-84732) ready to be issued once our vendor file has the required tax evidence on record. To confirm next steps, can you please provide the following by end of week?

I attached the PO terms summary and our onboarding checklist for reference. Once we have the signed tax form and a supporting letter, I will route PO-84732 for final approval and release.
